subject: Request: Vulnerability management evidence and SLA clarifications for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@wellstech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@wellstech.com
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 SIG follow-up: vulnerability management artifacts needed

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking the call today. As part of our SOC 2 and SIG review, our security team asked for a compact vulnerability management evidence packet we can include in our assessment. Would you be able to provide the following?

- Scan cadence (internal image/container/app scans + external penetration cadence) and proof (scan outputs).
- CVE remediation SLA ranges by severity and a recent example of a closure (ticket + timeline).
- Evidence of patch verification (post-deploy scan or test results).
- A short statement on exceptions/compensating controls and how you route critical CVEs.

We'd appreciate a single ZIP with redacted artifacts if possible. Attached is the SIG question extract that references these items.

Timeline: can you share this by EOD Friday Pacific? If not, a short ETA will work.

Thanks —
Anita Shah
Security Program Manager, WellsTech
[attachment: SIG_VM_Request_20280601.pdf (pdf)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 SIG follow-up: vulnerability management artifacts needed

Monica / Kim —

Forwarding WellsTech's ask (below). Can you assemble a compact evidence packet and proposed SLA statement? Key asks: scan cadence, CVE SLA by severity, example closure (ticket + timestamps), and patch verification proof. Prefer a single ZIP we can send directly to Anita.

Notes / constraints:
- Redact customer-identifying IPs and internal-only hostnames.
- Include small README that maps each artifact to the SIG question.

Monica — happy for you to lead the response. Kim, can you confirm the latest post-deploy scan artifacts exist for the May 2028 release and include the audit log excerpt showing verification?

Thanks —
Jonas
Head of Customer Security Engagements
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 SIG follow-up: vulnerability management artifacts needed

Jonas / Kim —

We assembled an evidence packet and recommend the following SLA statement for WellsTech. Packet contents (attached):

- vm_scan_summary_202805.zip: trimmed scan outputs for May run (container image scan + infra image scan).
- cve_remediation_timeline_v1.xlsx: canonical SLA table and three recent CVE closure examples (redacted).
- audit_post_scan_verification.txt: truncated audit log showing post-patch scan results and verification signatures.
- README_SIG_map.md: mapping of artifacts -> SIG question numbers.

Proposed CVE SLA (recommended):
- Critical: investigate within 24h, remediation and verification within 30 days (hotpatch path for exploit-in-the-wild exceptions: 72h).
- High: investigate within 48h, remediation and verification within 60 days.
- Medium: investigate within 7 days, remediation and verification within 90 days.
- Low: triage during next scheduled window (generally next monthly patch window).

Exceptions / compensating controls: when remediation introduces unacceptable customer impact we apply temporary network-level mitigations (WAF rules, rate limiting) and escalate to an incident runbook with executive notification. All exceptions are tracked in JIRA WM-4321 and require an owner and a deadline.

Attachments are redacted for PII and customer IPs per policy. I put the final ZIP in the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-wellstech-vm-evidence.

Kim — I included the audit excerpt showing the post-deploy scan on 2028-05-24 and the verification entry from our CI: 

--- audit_post_scan_verification.txt (excerpt) ---
2028-05-24T02:11:12Z | build-6421 | post-deploy-scan | PASS (no high/critical) | verifier=scanbot-3
2028-05-24T02:20:45Z | build-6421 | verification-signed | user=kpark, sig=sha256:aa1b...
--- end excerpt ---

I'll attach the ZIP to my reply to Anita unless you want to review first. ETA to Anita: EOD Thursday Pacific.

—Monica
Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vm_scan_summary_202805.zip (zip), attachment: cve_remediation_timeline_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@wellstech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@wellstech.com
Date: 2028-06-03T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 SIG follow-up: vulnerability management artifacts needed

Jonas / Monica —

Thank you for the fast turnaround and the packet. A couple quick clarifying questions from our assessor: 

1) For the Critical SLA, can you confirm whether the 30-day remediation window is the standard and whether you have ever invoked the 72h hotpatch path in the last 12 months (and if so, provide the non-sensitive timeline).
2) We need proof of the exception approval flow (who signs off on compensating controls) — can you provide a redacted approval record from JIRA or an approval email?
3) For the post-patch verification, can you confirm retention period for those audit logs (how long you retain verification artifacts)?

If you can drop the additional items into the same Drive folder and paste a DocuSign or approval link, that would wrap this checklist. Appreciate the speed — this looks close to complete.

Best —
Anita
Security Program Manager, WellsTech

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@wellstech.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 SIG follow-up: vulnerability management artifacts needed

Anita —

Thanks for the review notes. Quick answers:

1) The 30-day remediation window for Critical is our standard SLA when no public exploit is present. Over the last 12 months we invoked the expedited (72h) hotpatch path for 2 incidents — redacted timeline uploaded as "hotpatch_case_202803_redacted.txt" in the Drive folder.

2) Approval flow: exceptions require a named owner and the Security Director sign-off in JIRA. I've copied a redacted JIRA approval screenshot to the Drive (file: jra_approval_redacted.png) and linked the ticket ID WM-4321.

3) Audit retention: verification artifacts are retained for 540 days by default (evidence export in the Drive shows retention_policy_v2.pdf).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-wellstech-vm-evidence
JIRA: WM-4321

We'll add the two files you asked for into the same folder shortly. If that's sufficient I'll mark this as "evidence submitted" and we can route the assessor to the Drive link.

Regards —
Jonas
Head of Customer Security Engagements
Redwood Inference
